description: This file defines data models and a fetcher for handling equity profile data from the Financial Modeling Prep (FMP) API, including query parameters, data validation, and data transformation.

classes.name: FMPEquityProfileQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for fetching equity profile data from FMP.

classes.name: FMPEquityProfileData
classes.description: Represents the equity profile data returned from FMP, with validation and alias mappings.

classes.name: FMPEquityProfileFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming equity profile data from FMP API asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a FMPEquityProfileQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data for multiple symbols from the FMP API.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into a list of FMPEquityProfileData instances.

methods.name: validate_date
methods.description: Validates and converts the 'first_stock_price_date' to a date object.

methods.name: replace_empty_strings
methods.description: Replaces empty strings or 'NA' with None in data dictionaries.
